[data-catalog-image-fallback] { display:grid; place-content:center; height:100%; padding:20px; background:var(--card); color:var(--muted-foreground); font-size:var(--text-body); }

/* Catalog geometry only. Product and catalog inherit the same renderer palette,
typography and system preferences; this is no longer a second visual skin. */
/* Search is a foreground page mode. Its retained page owns no input or scroll
until dismissal; draft components and their local resource handles stay mounted. */
display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; width:100%; min-width:0; max-width:100%; margin-inline-start:auto;
/* Keep the rail stable while the actual rounded capsule grows. No reveal mask
or glyph scaling; the empty retained rail cannot intercept navigation. */
width:auto; min-width:0; flex:1 1 0; gap:0; visibility:hidden; opacity:0; pointer-events:none;
/* Content follows the shell, then leaves before contraction. The focused input
stays mounted and editable throughout; single-line text is never stretched. */
/* Give ink a perceptible fade within the unchanged shell expansion. The
former late 80ms emphasized curve looked like a delayed hard appearance. */
opacity:1; transition:opacity var(--dur-unfold) var(--ease-out) calc(var(--motion-overlay-enter) - var(--dur-unfold));
/* The focus ring follows the complete capsule, including intermediate widths. */

[data-catalog-search] [data-slot="input-group-control"] { height:var(--catalog-toolbar-height); min-height:0; padding:0; font:var(--text-body--font-weight) var(--text-body)/var(--text-body--line-height) var(--font-sans); color:var(--foreground); outline:none; }

[data-catalog-search-toggle] { position:relative; flex-shrink:0; pointer-events:auto; width:var(--catalog-toolbar-height); height:var(--catalog-toolbar-height); min-height:var(--catalog-toolbar-height); padding:0; }
/* Input ownership changes, but the underlying viewport and its edge geometry do not. */
/* Keep backdrop sampling at <=1 physical pixel per local CSS pixel. Chromium
otherwise leaks sharp clipped descendants at dense raster scales. Only this
empty material plane is scaled; retained content and controls never are.
Extent and blur compensate, preserving viewport bounds and a 16px blur. */

visibility:hidden; opacity:0; transition:opacity var(--motion-overlay-exit) var(--ease-exit),visibility 0s linear var(--motion-overlay-exit);
position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:4; overflow-y:auto; overscroll-behavior:contain; scrollbar-width:none;
/* Plane ownership is constant, including the outgoing transition. */
/* Toolbar placement follows the sidebar's measured docked/overlay presentation. */

browser reveals a focused descendant. Only data-catalog-scroll may move. */

[data-navigation-icon] { display:grid; place-items:center; flex:0 0 auto; width:max(24px,1.75em); height:max(24px,1.75em); border-radius:6px; color:var(--primary-foreground); background:var(--primary); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / .16); }

[data-catalog-navigation] [data-slot="sidebar-menu-button"] { height:auto; min-height:32px; padding:6px 10px; gap:9px; font-size:var(--text-body); line-height:var(--text-body--line-height); font-weight:var(--text-body--font-weight); border-radius:8px; }

[data-catalog-scroll] { position:relative; z-index:0; height:100%; overflow-y:auto; overscroll-behavior-y:contain; scrollbar-width:none; scroll-padding-block-start:calc(var(--catalog-toolbar-inset) + var(--catalog-toolbar-height) + var(--scroll-edge-feather,32px)); }

/* Anchored geometry and presence; Pane owns the material. */
/* State tint overlays the canonical material; it never recolors semantic ink.
Keep the hit target and perimeter fixed while its content compresses. The
neutral face response remains visible with reduced motion, including icons. */
/* Family measures stay stable while editing. A 3rem residual strip is absorbed
into the field. Queries measure the containing slot, never the device. */
/* Each cutoff is the preferred measure above plus the same 3rem allowance.
No width transition: resizing must not chase the pointer or reflow text late. */

Component-layer geometry cannot govern a compound Input/Button/Label. */

/* The real label height reserves space, including wrapping and text zoom.
Keeping it outside the editor also protects it from textarea scrolling. */
transition:transform var(--dur-snap) var(--ease-tm), font-size var(--dur-snap) var(--ease-tm);
/* Supporting copy follows the well's text guide, not its outer surface edge. */
/* The label describes the whole well; only the editing row shares width with
its clear target. Capacity follows actual type size, not a device category. */
/* A multiline editor needs its full reading measure. Its clear action moves
below it instead of narrowing every line for a single accessory. */

share the host's reading inset; only horizontal rails retain the outer lane. */
/* A Stack never removes or supplies a child's material. Standalone wells keep
their own boundary; only an actual row group owns a shared quiet surface. */
/* Measures belong to the component family, never the width of a specimen grid. */
/* Renderer-owned chrome decoration, composed over the existing native viewport.
